records.text: Owens alleged Alex Clark used the Bible in an anniversary episode to suggest women noticing lies were being led astray, and that the trailer portrayed Owens's podcast as a form of Gnosticism.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Alex Clark decided to release a whole episode to try to use the Bible, of course, to suggest that women who are noticing lies are actually being led astray and they're no longer they're straying from the Bible's teachings. So more on that when we come back from a brief break. ... I can't even believe that they've just gone so far. They are so unhinged that they're pretending that this podcast is a form of Gnosticism. No, actually, I am not the one that is hiding myself behind scripture and trying to tell people that they should follow me blindly and standing up on a stage and saying the Lord, the Lord, the Lord, the widow, the widow, the widow. And you're referring to yourselves.

records.text: It has been so hard for me in the last year just thinking about like, how can I ever forgive someone like Candace Owens?
